query_text: Sign up for a photography course at the community center

messages.content: Sign up for a photography course at the community center

message.content:
If you want to **sign up for a photography course at a community center**, the closest match in the results is the **Digital Photography** class at Virginia MOCA in Virginia Beach, which is a 6-week course for adults 16+ with no prior camera experience required.[1]

To enroll, the available information says the class runs **Wednesdays, May 6–June 10, 10:00 AM–12:00 PM**, and tuition is **$180 for members** or **$195 for nonmembers**.[1] It also requires a **digital SLR camera** and asks you to bring the **camera manual** and your preferred lens(es).[1]

If you meant a **traditional community center registration process**, Chesapeake’s Parks, Recreation and Tourism Department says you can register at your **nearest Chesapeake Community Center** or at the administrative office, and **pre-registration is required** for instructional classes.[10]

If you want, I can help you find the **best nearby beginner photography class** and tell you exactly **where to register** based on your city.
